"Edge case trigger: 'Root Cause'"

options.text: Standard BERT output is dimension 768, but ColBERT projects token embeddings down to linear bottleneck dimension $d=128$. Forgetting the projection layer causes $6\times$ memory explosion and dimension mismatches.
late_interaction_score() averages each query token's similarities across all document tokens instead of taking the max, diluting an excellent single-token match with unrelated tokens.
Document token embeddings are L2-normalized before the MaxSim computation, but query token embeddings are not, so cosine similarity is computed inconsistently.
The retriever compares query token embeddings against document embeddings indexed with an older, incompatible ColBERT checkpoint.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Standard BERT output is dimension 768, but ColBERT projects token embeddings down to linear bottleneck dimension $d=128$. Forgetting the projection layer causes $6\times$ memory explosion and dimension mismatches.

"Edge case trigger: 'Fix'"

options.text: Always apply the trained linear projection layer: $E{\text{projected}} = \text{LayerNorm}(W{\text{proj}} \cdot H{\text{bert}})$.
Replace the mean reduction in late_interaction_score() with a max reduction over document-token similarities.

Pad the 128-dimension ColBERT embeddings with zeros up to 768 dimensions so both tensors match shape.

question: When operating ColBERTv2 and Late Interaction workloads under high contention, which architectural defect leads to silent failure?

options.text: Use transactional atomic upserts and cascading deletes between vector index and parent document stores.
Every query re-runs the full BERT encoder over each candidate document's tokens at search time instead of reusing precomputed, indexed token embeddings.
The MaxSim computation materializes a full query-tokens by document-tokens similarity matrix for every candidate with no early pruning, so memory use scales with candidate count under load.
Token embeddings from two different model checkpoints get mixed into the same index after a partial re-embedding job is interrupted mid-run.

explanation: Root Cause Analysis: Use transactional atomic upserts and cascading deletes between vector index and parent document stores.

options.text: Ensuring index synchronization and embedding dimensional alignment for 06 colbertv2 and late interaction.
Comparing token embeddings from the query encoder directly against document embeddings from a different, unprojected 768-dimension checkpoint.
Reducing per-query-token similarity scores by averaging across all document tokens rather than taking the single best match.
Storing document token embeddings without ever validating that their dimensionality matches the query encoder's projected output dimension.

explanation: Retrieval accuracy requires maintaining strict index synchronization and embedding integrity in 06 colbertv2 and late interaction.
